title: Gated stored-leaf birthday search on secp256k1 over one-writer shared memory windows, two 55-bit VA ranges, at 123.275629189380648

claims.statement: Gated grouped stored-leaf birthday search (proof.md) recovers x from uniform secp256k1 Q=[x]P w.p. >= 0.39 (Q=O gives x=0). Coordinator 0 halts with no output unless a 128-bit RNDR u < K_GATE = 132747001558901520263382670112679088890 (p_gate ~ 0.390108376); else Phase-0 X-mining (E_mine <= 2^123.9033 insns; no output if a pool has < 4 valid pairs), then q1 = 103,079,062,500 batches in G = 6656 groups on 2^66 generators, 2^65 relays, 2^82 homes (CAP_H = 1,313,229,200,424,960) and 2^46 Y-relays. lo_run >= 0.999722189885 (rounded down), (K_GATE/2^128) lo_run >= 0.39 (exact rationals, c21). E_total = 256 insns + p_gate E_run <= 2^123.275629189380648 units of 1000 AArch64 insns (E_run <= 2^124.633683 units, <= 57.4910 insns/leaf of S = 2^128.754203); memory <= 2^137.9998 B; pre <= 2^116.2750 units; no advice; every run <= 2^172.9174 units (c55). Premise SW: nodes exchange data only through fixed one-writer shared memory windows, a premise about the system's memory map. Every store into memory another node maps and every load of another node's memory is an instruction of a shipped kernel, counted by executing it (set-up leaves a zero in each arrival and release word); a node's private set-up, its driver between barriers and REQ_SERVE, RESOLVE and XSETUP are itemized allowances; that a window is reachable from two nodes, and its wiring, are assumed and uncharged (proof.md premises, 5.1, 8). The hop-1 window row rests on a cited exponential-sum bound (Lemma J, success.md 6.4).

experiments.purpose: Runs the certificate's checks; every transport kernel of the shared-window machine on a memory model (one writer a window, a reader loads only what the cursor it loaded covers), path by path with controls; the leaf kernels on frames that reach them through the Y path; an end-to-end toy with barriers in two processor orders; the exponential sums of Lemma J on a toy curve. The run's work is fixed; seconds is not used.
